sudo -u postgres psql
CREATE DATABASE "TestBase";
\q

CREATE TABLE "BookingAgents" (
    "Id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Свободен',
    "BookedBy" TEXT,
    "BookingTime" TEXT,
    "ConnectionCommand" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'git/testo/virt-stand/xteso a1 u3'
);
